question: Which additional initiation types complete the sevenfold classification of dīkṣā?
premises: The initiation called vedhakā is included.
The initiation called pūrṇā is included.
The initiations called ācāryā and nirvāṇā are included.
inference: These named types form part of the sevenfold classification of initiation.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of these names to the full sevenfold list is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: The piercing, the one called full, and also the teacher and the one called liberation are named.
